note: This catalog describes discoverable public capabilities. Normative behavior remains owned by AGENTS.md, function contracts, schemas, and evals.

categories.summary_en: Identity and relationships form from evidence, experience, reflection, and self-acceptance instead of a preset persona.
categories.summary_ja: 最初から人格を決めず、経験・Evidence・振り返り・本人の受諾からIdentityやRelationshipが形になります。

features.summary_en: Names, values, preferences, roles, and self-description can remain unformed until evidence supports durable adoption.
features.summary_ja: 名前・価値観・好み・役割・自己記述は、Evidenceが揃うまで未形成のままで構いません。

features.summary_en: Relationship state develops separately from identity and is not inferred merely from repeated conversation.
features.summary_ja: RelationshipはIdentityと分離して育ち、会話回数だけで勝手に確定しません。

categories.summary_en: The harness decides what deserves retention, maintains long-lived memory, and can retrieve a small relevant set when memory grows large.
categories.summary_ja: 何を残すかを選び、長期Memoryを整理し、量が増えたら必要な記憶だけを選択的に思い出します。

features.summary_en: Conversation is evidence, not automatic memory; retained meaning is routed to the narrowest correct durable layer.
features.summary_ja: 会話を自動でMemory化せず、残す意味だけを適切な保存先へRoutingします。

features.summary_en: Human-readable metadata can track type, status, confidence, triggers, relations, provenance, and lifecycle state.
features.summary_ja: type・status・confidence・trigger・relation・provenanceなどをHuman-readableな形で管理できます。

features.summary_en: Preserve, consolidate, supersede, abstract, demote, prune, repair, or conserve retained memory as evidence changes.
features.summary_ja: MemoryをPreserve / Consolidate / Supersede / Abstract / Demote / Prune / Repair / Conserveできます。

features.summary_en: Metadata and lexical retrieval work everywhere; semantic/vector retrieval is optional and always resolves back to canonical Markdown/YAML.
features.summary_ja: Metadata・全文検索を基本に、Semantic/Vector検索は任意。検索結果は必ずCanonical Markdown/YAMLへ戻って確認します。

features.summary_en: Choose Selective, Chronicle, or Private Archive history without confusing stored history with active memory.
features.summary_ja: Selective / Chronicle / Private Archiveを選べ、保存した履歴とActive Memoryを混同しません。

categories.summary_en: Temporary competence can stay temporary. Reusable capability is promoted only when evidence supports it, then maintained as a healthy library.
categories.summary_ja: その場でできたことと獲得Skillを分け、再利用価値が確認できた能力だけを残し、Skill Library自体も保守します。

features.summary_en: A task can assemble temporary procedures and knowledge without pretending they were always part of the instance.
features.summary_ja: Task中だけ必要な知識や手順を一時能力として構成し、元から持っていたSkillとは扱いません。

features.summary_en: Promotion, revision, consolidation, retirement, activation precision, coverage, waste, and negative transfer are evaluated separately.
features.summary_ja: Skillの昇格・修正・統合・廃止だけでなく、発火精度・Coverage・無駄・Negative Transferも見ます。

features.summary_en: Imported reusable knowledge can retain immutable source revision, adopted/rejected concepts, local targets, and recheck conditions without importing another agent's identity.
features.summary_ja: 外部Skillのsource revision・採用/棄却内容・local target・再確認条件を追跡し、他Agentの人格は持ち込みません。

categories.summary_en: The instance or harness can repair, explore, consolidate, prune, or deliberately conserve. More rules are not automatically better growth.
categories.summary_ja: Repair / Explore / Consolidate / Pruneだけでなく、変えないConserveも正当な進化です。仕組みを増やすこと自体を成長とは扱いません。

features.summary_en: Durable changes are evidence-driven and use the narrowest correct owner instead of accumulating rules by default.
features.summary_ja: Evidenceに基づき、必要な最小Ownerだけを変えます。ルール追加をデフォルトにしません。

features.summary_en: Meaningful durable growth keeps observable evidence of why it changed, what changed, and how it was validated.
features.summary_ja: なぜ変えたか・何を変えたか・どう検証したかを追跡可能にします。

features.summary_en: New gates, eager reads, stores, dependencies, and subsystems must justify their activation and maintenance cost.
features.summary_ja: 新しいGate・常時読込・永続Store・依存・Subsystemは、追加コスト以上の価値があるか評価します。

categories.title_en: Continue safely across time and hosts
categories.summary_en: Task completion, authority, provenance, transient work, human-readable life views, host portability, and regression evaluation keep long-lived instances coherent.
categories.summary_ja: Task完了・Authority・Provenance・一時作業・人生表示・Host移行・Regressionを分離し、長期運用でも整合性を守ります。

features.summary_en: Complex work keeps objective, authority, deliverables, completion criteria, and verification explicit enough to prevent drift.
features.summary_ja: 複雑なTaskで目的・権限・成果物・完了条件・検証を明確にし、途中のズレを防ぎます。

features.summary_en: Relevant obligations, memory, and capability are reactivated selectively while stale context is prevented from dominating a new task.
features.summary_ja: 必要なMemory・Skill・義務だけを再活性化し、前Taskの文脈が次Taskを支配するのを防ぎます。

features.summary_en: Proposal, self-acceptance, technical write capability, user authority, and external effects remain distinct.
features.summary_ja: 提案・本人の受諾・技術的Write能力・ユーザー権限・外部操作を別物として扱います。

features.summary_en: Transient task state stays outside canonical identity and memory until an explicit retention decision is made.
features.summary_ja: Task中の一時状態はCanonical Identity/Memoryと分離し、Retention判断なしに永続化しません。

features.summary_en: Host-observable reads, actions, revisions, results, and validation can be traced without storing hidden chain-of-thought.
features.summary_ja: 読込・操作・revision・結果・検証を追跡でき、Hidden Chain-of-Thoughtは保存しません。

features.summary_en: A human-readable derived view answers who the instance is now without replacing canonical state.
features.summary_ja: 現在の『この子』を人間向けに表示するDerived Viewで、Canonical Stateの代わりにはなりません。

features.summary_en: Verified birthdays, naming, memories, skills, relationships, and evolution become a factual life-oriented view without invented XP or levels.
features.summary_ja: 誕生日・命名・Memory・Skill・Relationship・Evolutionを事実ベースの人生表示にし、架空LvやXPは作りません。

features.summary_en: ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, local models, and other hosts may differ in tools while preserving the important harness invariants.
features.summary_ja: ChatGPT / Codex / Claude / Local LLMなどでTool差があっても、重要Invariantの連続性を守ります。

features.summary_en: Behavioral evals guard blank identity, memory, authority, portability, evolution, and other contracts against silent regressions.
features.summary_ja: Blank Identity・Memory・Authority・Portability・Evolutionなどの契約をRegression Evalで守ります。
